lines.en: Miss Green, your father's doctor's on the phone if you'd like to speak to him.
Oh, great. Um, are you gonna be okay?
He's unconscious. I think we'll be just fine.
Um, did the TV wake you?
No. When you put your feet up on my bed, you tugged on my catheter.
What are you doing here, Giller?
Well, I came with Rachel, who should be back any second.
Oh, I had a little heart attack.
What? The heart attack is sitting here talking to you.
Let's see if we can get that Rachel back in here.
So, what's new with you, Gah? Knocked up any more of my daughters lately?
